## 你的功能建议是否与某个问题相关？ / Is your feature request related to a problem?

清晰简洁地描述这个问题。例如：当 [...] 时我总是感到困扰。
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## 你期望的解决方式 / Describe the solution you'd like

清晰简洁地描述你希望发生的行为。
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 你考虑过的替代方案 / Describe alternatives you've considered

清晰简洁地描述你考虑过的任何替代方案或功能。
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 影响范围 / Which area does this affect?

- [ ] 前端 UI / Frontend UI
- [ ] 后端（Docker / Express）/ Backend (Docker / Express)
- [ ] Worker（Cloudflare Pages / Hono）/ Worker (Cloudflare Pages / Hono)
- [ ] AI 功能 / AI features
- [ ] DNS / Workers / Pages / Storage
- [ ] 文档 / Documentation
- [ ] 其他 / Other

## 补充说明 / Additional context

在此补充关于该功能建议的其他背景、原型或截图。
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
